end.parentNote: Asha practised showing numbers as one bundle of ten plus loose ones. Saanvi used the loose objects for counting and, when reminded that the bundle contains ten sticks, reached 14 once, but continued to count the bundle as one in later examples. At home, practise with a group of 10 pencils tied together: say “10 and 3 makes 13,” then count on from 10.
